distinction_from_form_b: Owned-land alternative and explicit opening-capital ROIC transition rather than mutually exclusive project and FCFE reverse valuation.
Nonzero debt-beta risk transfer, priced gamble/commitment and a two-quarter maximum payout rather than APV financing-policy mismatch and repurchase.
Complete industrial/software universe and market-priced exclusive delay plus early-only receipt rather than abandonment/staged continuation.
Endogenous fixed-share acquisition and post-pricing venture pool/preferred rights rather than cash consideration, EPS, LBO and fund returns.
Recourse deficiency, individually acceptable transfer interval and stress resource impossibility rather than the reassessment refinancing/governance mechanism.
review_scope: All twenty original prompts, complete solutions and five-point rubrics read and solved against the exact stated inputs; root independently read every pair before the final wording repairs.

Compared tasks with accepted c01-c12 teaching. Every chapter outcome maps to at least one substantive assessed part; the exam is cumulative without asserting exhaustive coverage of all chapter subtopics.

Checked date-0 opportunity outlay versus new cash, year-3 opening-capital return and after-reinvestment FCFF, terminal exclusion of date-2 FCFF, matching nominal currency and supplied risk assumptions.

Checked no-tax rather than tax-shield beta formulas; positive state-pricing weights; payoff conservation; old fixed debt versus prospective anticipated debt issue; covenant comparison does not prove that debt issuance dominates staying unlevered.
Reconciled all dates in both payout paths, simultaneous draw/payment rule, gross principal capacity and interest on opening principal; contractual maximum is not an unprovided economic optimum.
Checked every peer, including excluded software, and all lease/NCI/cash/holding claim bridges; criterion is set before prices and unsupported normalization is not allowed.
Independently replicated option state payoffs and compared the early-only receipt at date 0; physical probability is not used as a pricing weight.
Checked closing acquisition resources, surviving debt/preferred claims, ordinary-share purchase boundary and sum of old-group gains; no closing cash cost is deducted twice.

Checked venture pool timing, all four ownership fractions, investor conversion versus preference, other-holder residual and the distinction between contractual headline value and common-claim fair value.

Checked deficiency participation once, all liquidation cash, new lender fair value, baseline class vetoes, transfer endpoints and conditional stress funding; no fictitious financing commitment or jurisdictional law imported.
Explicit error carry-forward, domain scores, pass threshold, completed solutions hidden after all prompts, unique IDs and one-to-one solution mappings verified.

Pricing, taxes, trade, funding availability and recovery rights are stipulated fictional facts. These methods do not authenticate real evidence or establish legal duties.
